test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

I reached the office before time as I __want to completed__ some pending jobs.
solution:
The correct answer is **'wanted to complete'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the aforementioned sentence, the verb form for completed should be in the base form: **complete**.
 
• This is because it is part of the **to**-**infinitive **following **want**.
 
• Since the sentence is in **the past tense**, the verb want should be used with modifier -**ed**: **wanted**.

 

**Hence, the correct sentence is__:* ****I reached the office before time as__** I wanted to complete**__ some pending jobs.*
